prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide landscape artwork for a Bloodline Awakening rank card in Shinobi Journey, a dark Japanese shinobi fantasy RPG. Create one polished painterly game illustration, tactile hand-painted realism, cinematic temple shadows, worn materials and elegant original shinobi ritual motifs. Wide 3:2 composition, main relic centered and fully visible in the middle 65 percent of frame; dark breathing room at edges. Close view at altar height. No people, no text, no letters, no numerals, no UI, no border, no watermark. Richly visible relic, atmospheric but not so dark that the subject disappears at small sizes. Subject: an ancestral bone charm necklace, several carved ivory fang talismans with subtle etched spiral marks, strung on aged indigo cord and bronze fittings, hanging just above a cracked black stone ritual altar. A restrained emerald chakra aura threads between the ivory charms, soft drifting green wisps. Background: shadowed timber shrine, sacred rope, fog, softly blurred stone pillars. Ivory bone and oxidized bronze, charcoal and deep indigo shadows, emerald rim light. Heroic ancestral inheritance, not horror or gore.
